metric_definitions.name: Held-out perplexity
metric_definitions.definition: exp of global mean NLL in nats over all scored held-out tokens; mean NLL reported as heldout_nll
metric_definitions.source: tacodevs card Quality table; our choice on aggregation

metric_definitions.name: Perplexity delta vs original
metric_definitions.definition: candidate PPL - original PPL on the identical holdout

metric_definitions.name: Held-out mean NLL
metric_definitions.definition: global mean negative log-likelihood, natural log, full vocab, T=1

metric_definitions.name: Held-out KL(original || candidate)
metric_definitions.definition: mean over scored tokens of KL between full-vocabulary softmaxes at temperature 1, natural log

metric_definitions.name: Held-out top-1 agreement
metric_definitions.definition: percent of scored positions where argmax(candidate) == argmax(original), lowest-index tie-break, identical position set

metric_definitions.name: On-policy NLL (assistant tokens)
metric_definitions.definition: NLL of reference-generated assistant spans under a model; prompt/tool/system tokens never scored

metric_definitions.name: On-policy NLL delta
metric_definitions.definition: candidate NLL - original NLL on identical scored spans

metric_definitions.name: On-policy KL(original || candidate)
metric_definitions.definition: same definition as heldout_kl on assistant spans

metric_definitions.name: On-policy top-1 agreement
metric_definitions.definition: same definition as heldout_top1_agreement on assistant spans; ALL group is the definition-identical tacodevs anchor

metric_definitions.name: On-policy NLL over agent trajectories
metric_definitions.definition: reference-generated continuations over validation/torture trajectory prefixes, scored per slice group and context bucket

metric_definitions.name: Agreement by slice group (code/reasoning/agent/general/ALL)
metric_definitions.definition: top-1 agreement restricted to scored positions whose episode primary_capability maps to the group; ALL row additionally comparable to tacodevs

metric_definitions.name: NLL delta by slice group
metric_definitions.definition: candidate - original mean NLL within the group

metric_definitions.name: Long-context degradation (per context bucket)
metric_definitions.definition: candidate - original NLL for segments whose prefix length falls in the bucket; slope = delta(128K+) - delta(<8K)

metric_definitions.name: Long-context agreement degradation (per context bucket)
metric_definitions.definition: candidate top-1 agreement - original top-1 agreement within bucket

metric_definitions.name: Adjudicated pathological-generation rate
metric_definitions.definition: human-adjudicated (blind to model_id) positives of automated structural flags, by category enum

metric_definitions.name: Paired task success
metric_definitions.unit: rate + task-cluster 95% CI; ratio; wins/losses/ties; exact McNemar where seeds allow
metric_definitions.definition: produced by paired.py over stage-3/stage-4 task-outcome JSONL per docs/evaluation-methodology.md sections 3 and 5

metric_definitions.name: Protocol negative-control pass rate
metric_definitions.definition: record_type=negative_control pass rate reported separately by paired.py (methodology section 6)

metric_definitions.name: Catastrophe rate on matched pairs
metric_definitions.definition: observed catastrophic input rate and delta from paired.py catastrophes section

metric_definitions.name: Prompt-processing throughput (PP8K/PP32K/PP64K/PP128K)
metric_definitions.label: PRE-OPTIMISATION
metric_definitions.definition: llama-bench in-process batched prompt processing; never concurrency; commands per docs/hardware-bringup.md section G

metric_definitions.name: Decode concurrency C1/C4/C8
metric_definitions.label: PRE-OPTIMISATION
metric_definitions.definition: real concurrent HTTP requests against one server (C1 single request decode); batch flags never reported as concurrency

metric_definitions.name: Theoretical weight bytes read per decoded token
metric_definitions.definition: arithmetic from exact inventory (protected non-expert bytes + active expert bytes for top-k routing under the candidate recipe); computed, not measured

metric_definitions.name: Active-weight bandwidth
metric_definitions.definition: theoretical_bytes_per_token x measured decode tokens-per-second / 1e9; a derived diagnostic only

mapping.general: residual scored assistant tokens not covered by any labeled episode

slice_groups.coverage_rule: every one of the 22 tags maps to exactly one group; ALL = union of the four groups

context_buckets.note: <8K is the assignment's 8K-and-below slice; every bucket publishes its scored-token count; small-N buckets are marked inconclusive, never zero-filled

judges.tier_1: deterministic automated structural detectors (repetition factor, tool-call parse failures, claim-vs-tool-output contradiction, scope checks); never an LLM judge
judges.tier_2: human adjudication blind to model_id; counted rate = adjudicated positives; refuted flags counted separately for detector calibration

recording.private: $MIMO_LAB/eval/pathology/ (category, bucket, group, detector, adjudication per incident)
recording.public: counts and rates only (incidents per 100 scored generations by category); stage-4 runner outcomes additionally flow into task-outcome JSONL catastrophic/failure_category fields
recording.git_policy: no raw generations, prompts, trace content or paths in Git-tracked outputs

inputs: on-policy set: >=40 responses generated from original official weights under recorded sampling config
metrics: artifact gate: tensor inventory, dtype changes, NaN/Inf, reload round-trip

kill_criterion.absolute_not_calibrated: artifact-gate failure, NaN/Inf, or unloadable weights kill immediately
kill_criterion.spread_calibrated: delta_ppl, delta_kl, delta_top1 thresholds vs the best candidate
kill_criterion.provisional_rule: kill candidates strictly dominated on all three distribution metrics by another candidate at equal-or-larger weight budget

stages.compute_note: teacher-forced passes over ~524288-token calibration-equivalent budgets plus 63K held-out tokens and the on-policy set; single GPU pass; hours per candidate

kill_criterion.provisional_rule: kill on (a) any primary slice (code/reasoning/agent) dominated by another candidate on both slice_delta_nll and slice_agreement, (b) long-context slope worse than best candidate + delta_ctx, or (c) adjudicated pathology rate above original reference + delta_path

stages.compute_note: reference generation over trajectory prefixes plus teacher-forced scoring; GPU-hours per candidate

inputs: candidate suites (our choice; names from upstream REAP eval branches recorded in docs/hope-objective.md section 6): evalplus HumanEval+ and MBPP+ (pass@1), LiveCodeBench via lcb_runner at a pinned release window, one lm-eval small reasoning subset, plus level-5 protocol negative controls (methodology section 6)
metrics: suite pass@1 and suite-native scores with paired seeds

kill_criterion.spread_calibrated: delta_bench provisional band, seeded by stage-1 spread until stage-3 numbers exist
kill_criterion.provisional_rule: kill a candidate whose reduced-suite retention falls below the sweep's provisional floor or whose paired CI is strictly below parity vs the reference; release-gate shapes from methodology section 6 (e.g. short coding retention >=93%) apply at release time, never as stage-3 auto-pass

stages.compute_note: hours to ~1 day per candidate on one machine

inputs: Pareto-frontier candidates from stages 1-3 (quality vs bytes; throughput excluded from the frontier)
stage4-golden frozen bank (currently not_ready: 0 eligible of 235 reserved - reported unavailable, never substituted)
full-window agentic suite (SWE-bench-class public-repo agent suite; our choice; no tacodevs counterpart exists)
metrics: task_success_paired on golden (rates, task-cluster 95% CIs, ratio, wins/losses/ties, McNemar where applicable)

kill_criterion.status: no automatic kill; decisions are Pareto-frontier plus golden paired outcome; CIs straddling parity are inconclusive by construction (methodology section 5); throughput never removes a candidate from the quality frontier

comparability_notes: tacodevs published no benchmark or task-success numbers (task_success null): stages 3-4 have no counterpart and are never compared to a nonexistent published value
their on-policy slice labeling method is unpublished: the ALL row is the definition-identical anchor; group rows are in-spirit comparable only
their NLL/KL log bases are presumed natural and stated as such; we record our bases explicitly so the comparison stays honest

performance_diagnostics.label: PRE-OPTIMISATION
performance_diagnostics.rule: current runtime kernel quality differs by datatype; throughput is an implementation artifact, never a compression property
performance_diagnostics.commands_source: docs/hardware-bringup.md section G (llama-bench prompt processing; benchmark_matrix.py concurrency)

claims_and_prohibitions: distribution metrics are controls, never task success; a high-agreement candidate with a worse golden paired outcome loses
quality decides the winner; high-quality candidates are never rejected for poor current throughput and worse candidates never selected for a lucky kernel
tacodevs numbers are publisher-reported with independently_reproduced=false; reproducing their method is comparability work, not endorsement
golden never enters calibration or method selection; bank reported unavailable until reserved+eligible >= 50
no raw trace content, prompts, repo identifiers, secrets or absolute local paths in Git-tracked outputs; private artifacts stay under $MIMO_LAB
missing measurements stay null/unavailable, never zero, never inferred
thresholds marked CALIBRATED AFTER STAGE-1 SPREAD are non-binding until calibrated and written back into this file
every candidate is built from the original Xiaomi source (revision 5711b268169967567844e1e560e8a3966da959b1); the tacodevs MLX checkpoint is prior information only
